citations.assessment: Rav Ashi quotes the exilarch’s household asking about a mixed group of animals. The exilarch designation is attached to Rav Neḥemyah.
The receiving Ukvan article cites the exilarch called Ukvan bar Neḥemyah in Bava Batra. A relationship to this particular Neḥemyah is only Heilprin’s conjecture.

holds.reason: The separate source gives Ukvan’s patronymic, but does not identify his father with the Bava Metzia exilarch.
